mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_turn( task_id, turn_no, phase, action_type, action_json, observation_summary, status, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_ms, created_at ) SELECT #{taskId}, #{turnNo}, #{phase}, #{actionType}, #{action,typeHandler=com.zzy.finsight.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.ObjectJsonTypeHandler}, '', 'PLANNED', #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt} FROM research_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch}

INSERT INTO agent_tool_call( task_id, turn_id, call_id, tool_name, arguments_hash, arguments_json, status, attempt_no, duration_ms, started_at ) SELECT #{taskId}, #{turnId}, #{callId}, #{toolName}, #{argumentsHash}, #{arguments,typeHandler=com.zzy.finsight.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.ObjectJsonTypeHandler}, 'RUNNING', #{attemptNo}, 0, #{startedAt} FROM research_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, turn_no, phase, action_type, action_json, observation_summary, status, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_ms, created_at FROM agent_turn WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY turn_no ASC

SELECT id, task_id, turn_no, phase, action_type, action_json, observation_summary, status, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_ms, created_at FROM agent_turn WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND turn_no = #{turnNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_id, turn_id, call_id, tool_name, arguments_hash, arguments_json, result_json, status, attempt_no, duration_ms, error_code, error_message, started_at, completed_at FROM agent_tool_call WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id ASC
